prompt: I run a window cleaning company. Per the Brick & Mortar Funnels book, how do I figure out how much I can spend to get a customer and what offers and steps should I use to get 100 new clients?
assertions: Explains max CAC = annual revenue per client x profit margin (e.g., $40 x 30 = $1,200 x 25% = $300)
Explains the value ladder / front-end offers (e.g., 10 exterior windows for $99)
Says to build one landing page per single offer (not a broad website)
Lists ad copy elements: hook headline, body, benefits, urgency/scarcity
Covers traffic sources including emailing existing clients, Facebook posts/Live, and Facebook ads, then measuring results
Adds at least one other expert tactic from the book (e.g., Shaule reactivation/SMS or review/referral funnel, Frey referrals)
